description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController that provides basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing endpoints for greeting, documentation, health status, and application info.
